body:
Owner requested implementation and evaluation of PageIndex-inspired heading navigation on 2026-09-29. Build an isolated experimental harness over a pinned docs/specs and decisions slice. Preserve existing Core retrieval behavior. Equal-byte baseline and section-navigation arms; paired same-model reading trial; retain losses and unknown telemetry. Draft PR publication is authorized; merge remains owner-controlled.

Implementation and pilot published as draft https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/351 on codex/heading-navigation. Source commit 71bc3167; bound commit bd12e58c700602436e59c5b71a6ac9db49cc9998; seal 651c5310. Frozen 6000-byte pilot: evidence 3/13 to 7/13, complete answers 4/8 to 5/8, unsupported conclusions 0 to 1. No promotion or token/cost savings claim. Focused harness/corpus tests, vet, docs checks and independent protocol/code/results/CEM review PASS. Enrolled local workflow satisfied at bound commit; make dogfood-check and dogfood-seal PASS. Existing44 DCP/REC obligations remain unassessed and advisory frontier OPEN. Full make gate NOT_RUN under scoped policy. Retained evidence: tools/heading-nav-bench/results/pilot and docs/build-log/2026-09-29-heading-navigation.md. Keep OPEN: merge/integration requires owner approval, then native completion disposition/receipt audit; installed Tasks runtime does not expose submit/gate run/complete.
